blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Here are INQToday’s top stories this afternoon: Super Typhoon Rosal, internationally known as Champi, has entered the Philippine area of responsibility, prompting the raising of Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal No. 1 over parts of Northern and Southern Luzon; Taal Volcano recorded a minor phreatic eruption on Tuesday; and House lawmakers are eyeing an inquiry into possible links between pro-China propaganda networks and online supporters of Vice President Sara Duterte, according to Bicol Saro Rep. Terry Ridon./dp READ: Super Typhoon Rosal enters PAR; Signal No. 1 in 5 Luzon areas... Keep on reading: WATCH: ST Rosal enters PAR, Taal activity top INQToday newscast
